open_world.raw_value: after giving such notice and prior to effecting such Parent Change of Recommendation, Parent negotiates (and causes its officers, employees, financial advisor and outside legal counsel to negotiate) in good faith with the Company (to the extent the Company wishes to negotiate) to make such adjustments or revisions to the terms of this Agreement as would permit the Parent Board not to effect a Parent Change of Recommendation in response thereto

attributes.why_unmapped: substantive duty to negotiate revisions with the Company during the notice period; no PREREQUISITE_CODE captures a negotiate-in-good-faith duty

attributes.why_unmapped: advance-notice requirement before waiving a standstill provision; not a receipt-of-proposal notice or a recommendation-change match window
